按 Esc 取消录入；要输出 Esc，请点此按钮。: Press Esc to cancel recording; use this button to assign Esc as output.
单独绑定时按住即输出；同一输入还有长按动作时，需在长按时间前松开才输出。: Activates while held on its own. If the same input has a long-press action, release before the long-press threshold to activate.
松开后确认短按。与长按使用相同时间分界，可分配不同动作。: Short presses are confirmed on release. Use the same time boundary as a long press to assign separate actions.
达到长按时间后触发，可保持到松开或只触发一次。: Activates after the hold time. Keep the output held until release, or fire a single pulse.
在时间窗内再次按下时触发，第二次按住期间持续输出。: Press again within the time window to activate. The output stays pressed during the second hold.
单独绑定时按下即输出；同一输入还有长按动作时，需在长按时间前松开才输出。下方数值: Fires on press on its own. If the same input has a long-press action, release before the long-press threshold to fire. The value below sets the output duration.
每次松开时输出一次，持续时间由下方设置决定。: Fires once on each release, for the duration set below.
全部松开后完成 · 点击取消: Release all inputs to finish · Click to cancel
点击录入键鼠: Click to record keyboard or mouse
松开后完成 · 滚轮立即录入 · 点击取消: Release to finish · Scroll records immediately · Click to cancel
支持键盘、鼠标按钮、侧键与四向滚轮: Keyboard, mouse buttons, side buttons and four scroll directions
可组合最多 4 项。再次选择可移除，滚轮最多一个方向。: Combine up to 4 outputs. Select again to remove. Only one scroll direction is allowed.
选择一个普通输出，Ctrl／Alt／Shift 可独立叠加。: Choose a main output and add Ctrl, Alt or Shift independently.
选择要编辑的层；按住启用输入时才会在游戏中生效。: Choose the layer to edit. It only activates in the game while its input is held.
配置层与当前配置一起保存。选择编辑层不会立即启用它，游戏中仍由按住输入控制。: Layers are saved with the current profile. Selecting an editing layer does not activate it; the held input controls activation in the game.
请输入 0–5000 毫秒之间的整数。: Enter a whole number from 0 to 5000 milliseconds.
光标状态连续保持该时间后才切换。设为 0 可取消额外等待；检测仍受约 50 ms: The cursor state must stay unchanged for this long before switching. Set 0 to remove the extra wait; detection still depends on the roughly 50 ms polling interval and profile loading. Press Enter or leave the field to save.
光标状态确认时间应在 0 到 5000 毫秒之间: Cursor state confirmation time must be between 0 and 5000 milliseconds
